requirements: Full replay-bundle export requires active DISCLOSE authority on the relationship aggregate resource.
READ authority does not substitute for DISCLOSE authority.
Purpose, expiry, conditions, lifecycle restrictions, revocation, and permission-race semantics apply to replay export through the ordinary capability path.
Denied replay export fails closed and records the governance decision.
Authorized replay export records an ALLOW decision before constructing the bundle, so the exported history contains its disclosure authorization event.
Bundle verification and import do not themselves grant source disclosure authority.
